evidence.source: SI section 2/Table S1 assigns compound 2 to CCDC 2512981 and reports formula C18H14B2N6O12F12S4.
Main paper data-availability/crystallographic statement cites CCDC 2512981-2512983.
Main paper computational discussion assigns compound 2's dominant absorption chiefly to HOMO-4 to LUMO and gives 323 nm and f=0.4243; its printed 4.33 eV is inconsistent with that wavelength.
Main paper continuation interprets the compound-2 orbital ordering in terms of electron-withdrawing triflate substituents and N6-related orbitals.
SI computational-study section states Gaussian 16, B3LYP/6-31+G(d), SMD dichloromethane and DFT-D3BJ for optimization and TD-DFT.
SI Table S3 compound-2 state list reports the fifth singlet at 3.8436 eV, 322.58 nm and f=0.4243.
SI Table S3 continuation assigns the dominant 217 to 222 configuration coefficient 0.70241, corresponding to HOMO-4 to LUMO.
